values.meaning: Duration of the Crimson Rush surge before it fully depletes (the window to land the empowered cast)
Crimson Rush stacks required to trigger the surge (arms the next Transfusion as the empowered cast)
values.binNote: The wiki states the surge triggers at 2 stacks of Crimson Rush. VladimirQ's data values have no named stack-cap row for this. sheet.json's top-level resource block (arType 8, values {726ee5cd}=2, {c4ab3550}=0) plausibly encodes the resource max/start as 2/0, matching the wiki, but its keys are unlabeled hashes rather than a spell row kit_sources.py sheet prints, so it is not cited with confidence.

mechanics.claim: Transfusion generates 1 point of Crimson Rush over the course of its cooldown (i.e. stacks build up while the ability is on cooldown after being cast).
mechanics.quote: He then generates 1 point of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' over the {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: At 2 points of Crimson Rush, Vladimir surges; casting Transfusion during the surge consumes all Crimson Rush to deal 85% increased damage.
mechanics.quote: At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining

mechanics.claim: Once triggered, the surge (Crimson Rush) depletes over 2.5 seconds, so the empowered cast must land inside that window or the charge is lost.
Crimson Rush depletes 75% slower while Vladimir is in Sanguine Pool, channeling Tides of Blood, or in stasis, extending the window to land the empowered Transfusion.
mechanics.quote: ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes 75% slower during ''{{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}}'', ''{{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}}'', or {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.

mechanics.claim: Although visualized as a projectile, Transfusion's healing (and by the same cast, presumably its damage) triggers as soon as the 0.25s cast time completes, not on a travel delay.
mechanics.quote: the healing itself triggers as soon as the cast time completes.

mechanics.claim: Vladimir can cast Sanguine Pool and Hemoplague during Transfusion's cast time, so the 0.25s cast does not block those other abilities.
mechanics.quote: '''Vladimir''' can cast {{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}} and {{ai|Hemoplague|Vladimir}} during ''Transfusion's'' cast time.
